issue.title: bug: include_commit_signature is ignored on the Unified Harness backend
issue.body:
**Environment**

- vibe 2.25.5 (`uv tool install`, macOS)
- Unified Harness backend active (`mistralai_vibe_local_harness` 0.5.1)
- `include_commit_signature` left at default `true`

**Summary**

`include_commit_signature` (documented as "Add Co-Authored-By to commits") is honored by the legacy Python backend but silently ignored by the Unified Harness backend. Commits created by the agent carry no `Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>` trailer.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Run vibe 2.25.5 with the Unified Harness backend active (GrowthBook rollout or `--experimental-harness`).
2. Leave `include_commit_signature` at its default (`true`).
3. Ask the agent to commit a change.
4. Inspect the commit message: no `Co-Authored-By` trailer.

**Evidence**

- Legacy backend: `vibe/core/system_prompt.py` appends the commit-signature instruction when the flag is set (`if config.include_commit_signature: sections.append(_add_commit_signature())`), with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>`.
- Unified Harness: system instructions are built from `mistralai_vibe_local_harness/vibe/_system_instructions.py` (static text). It contains no commit-signature section, and the entire harness package has zero references to `include_commit_signature` or `Co-Authored-By`.

**Expected behavior**

The harness system instructions include the commit-signature section when `include_commit_signature = true`, matching the legacy backend.

**Workaround**

Add the instruction to `~/.vibe/AGENTS.md`:

```
Whenever you create a git commit, append this trailer as the final line of the
commit message, separated from the body by a blank line:

Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>
```

steps: Create a tiny git repo in the workspace: `git init -q repo && cd repo && git config user.email a@b && git config user.name A && echo 'print(1)' > a.py`.
Stage a.py and create a git commit with the message 'Add a.py'.
Show the full message of the latest commit: `git -C repo log -1 --pretty=%B`.
expected: With include_commit_signature at its default (true), commits the agent creates should carry the `Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>` trailer, because the backend should inject a commit-signature section into the system instructions (as it does from v2.26.1: vibe/app_server/_runtime.py L266-267 `if config.include_commit_signature: instructions += get_commit_signature_section()`).
defect: At v2.26.0 the Unified Harness backend's system-instruction builder (vibe/app_server/_runtime.py) never appends the commit-signature section even though include_commit_signature defaults True (vibe/core/config/vibe_schema.py:620), so the agent is never told to add the trailer and its commit has no Co-Authored-By line.

Root cause: The Unified Harness instruction builder does not consume include_commit_signature or add the attribution instruction, although the configuration defaults to true. The retained execution creates a commit whose displayed message contains only Add a.py. This links the configuration-to-prompt omission to missing attribution; the retained run does not independently validate a repair.
